law_of_malryck.name: Law of Malryck
laws: The Crown of Etgard, and the lineage of the Domans is the perpetual and inalienable property of the House of Shirleigh. It is the fount of all laws, honours and privileges, and no person of other blood may ever wear the Crown.
The Elemental Church is granted its land, rights and the power to enforce its Canon Law upon the island. It may exist and function in peace, as stipulated by The Treatise.
All persons upon Domotan know no other Master than House Shirleigh; their Majesties and their Heirs and Successors. Excepted are foreign dignitaries and those of note as recognised by the Crown.
All subjects are permitted to freely petition the Crown for an audience. Entry at Etgard Keep is at the pleasure of House Shirleigh. To thieve from the estate of Etgard is treason.
